premises.text: Healthcare can be transformed through technology to improve patient care.
premises.evidence_span: you can replace most of these things with technology.

premises.text: A healthcare system can be built without physical hospitals by using a technology platform.
premises.evidence_span: world's largest hospital won't be about buildings. Instead, it's going to be ubiquitous technology platform that connects us with our doctors.

premises.text: Patients can manage their health information and interactions through a mobile app.
premises.evidence_span: you can send those prescriptions to your house. You can reschedule your appointments.

premises.text: A hybrid model of virtual and in-person care can enhance patient experience.
premises.evidence_span: we basically built a hybrid, a seamless hybrid of virtual and in-person care.

premises.text: Automated questions can streamline the patient intake process.
premises.evidence_span: we've automated a lot of the questions that your doctor would be asking you to save time.

premises.text: Patients can receive follow-up care virtually after in-person visits.
premises.evidence_span: when you leave the clinic, you can choose to do follow-ups virtually if you wish.

value.text: Patients receive improved healthcare experiences through a technology-driven system.
value.evidence_span: we are able to design an experience that would be impossible for the traditional healthcare providers.

notes: No separate premises for the various features of the app as they all contribute to the same healthcare experience.
